lessons.title: 坐姿與指法
lessons.subtitle: 認識基準位和十指分工

slides.title: 坐得正，打得久
points: 眼睛平視螢幕上緣，距離約一隻手臂
手肘彎成約 90 度，手腕不要壓在桌上

slides.title: 基準位：手指的「家」
points: 左手四隻手指放在 A S D F
右手四隻手指放在 J K L ;
兩隻拇指輕放在空白鍵上
每次按完鍵，手指都要回到基準位

slides.title: F 和 J 上的小凸點
points: F 鍵和 J 鍵上各有一條小凸起
不用看鍵盤，兩隻食指摸到凸點就找到基準位
現在試試閉上眼睛，用食指找出 F 和 J

slides.title: 十指分工
points: 每隻手指負責一條斜行的鍵，顏色相同的鍵用同一隻手指
紫色：尾指　藍色：無名指　綠色：中指　橙色：食指
兩隻食指負責的鍵最多，各有兩行

slides.title: 盲打：不看鍵盤
points: 開始時會慢，這是正常的
先求準，再求快：準確率比速度重要
打錯了不用急，按回正確的鍵就可以

lessons.title: 句子與短段落
lessons.subtitle: 把一段完整的文字打出來

steps.title: 第 1 段
steps.hint: 大寫、標點都要打對。慢一點沒關係。
steps.text: My name is Ken and I am in Form One. I go to school by MTR every morning. My favourite lesson is Computer because we learn to type with ten fingers.

steps.title: 第 2 段
steps.hint: 句子之間按一下空白鍵。
steps.text: It was a hot day in July. Mum and I took a ferry to Cheung Chau. We rode bikes, ate fish balls and swam at the beach. I was tired but happy when we got home.

steps.title: 第 3 段
steps.hint: 留意逗號和感嘆號。
steps.text: Our class is planning a party for the end of term. Amy will bring cups and plates, Ben will make a poster, and I will choose the music. We hope everyone can come!

steps.title: 第 4 段
steps.hint: 保持穩定的節奏，眼睛看螢幕。
steps.text: Typing is a useful skill. At first it feels slow because you must not look at the keys. Keep your fingers on the home row, sit up straight and practise for ten minutes a day.

steps.title: 過關小測
steps.hint: 60 秒內打得愈多愈好，速度達 15 WPM、準確率達 90% 即過關。
steps.text: Last Saturday our class visited a farm in the New Territories. The farmer showed us how to plant lettuce and pick tomatoes. We also fed the goats, which were very hungry and a little noisy. At lunch we ate the vegetables we had picked, and they tasted much better than the ones from the supermarket. Before we left, the farmer gave each of us a small pot with a seed in it. Mine has already started to grow!
